words.gloss: words of full power or accomplished speech

literal: The greatness of the people of accomplished speech, on the earth, their hidden words will surely show.
translation: The greatness of sages of accomplished speech is revealed to the world by their sublime, hidden words.
modern: நிறைந்த ஆற்றல் உடைய சொற்களைப் பேசும் சான்றோர்களின் பெருமையை, அவர்கள் உலகிற்குத் தந்த மறைமொழிகளே (மந்திரங்களே) காட்டிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how the greatness of realized sages who possess powerful, accomplished speech is made known to the world. Their 'hidden words', which refer to mantras or profound sacred utterances, serve as the ultimate proof of their spiritual stature. The power and truth of their words naturally reveal their greatness to everyone on earth without the need for external praise.
